freshChecks.runtime: Python 3.12.14; existing Pillow image metadata reader
freshChecks.chromeExecutable: not found in checked runtime locations
freshChecks.coreH1Exception: products/index.html is dynamic shell with no initial H1

limitations: Homepage only; fallback fonts; synthetic backend substitutions.
Wider screenshot bytes not recovered via tested connector; historical metrics inspected.
No fresh shopping, 200% text, screen-reader, physical-device or production acceptance.

findings.problem: Initial catalogue top-level await can reject before downstream page catches execute.
findings.customerImpact: Missing or unresolved purchasing-state feedback; basket/checkout content depends on successful module startup.
findings.securityEgress: Preserve fail-closed store/stock/server authority; no stale purchase or image-bearing fallback; no extra reads.
acceptance: Initial 401/402/500/timeout/malformed response yields accessible unavailable state on each affected route.
Local basket intent preserved; safe navigation remains reachable.
Success and empty states work without new backend reads or production requests.

findings.problem: FAQ says checkout/payment are not enabled while purchase surfaces describe secure checkout.
findings.securityEgress: No assumption of current OPEN or provider recovery; no business-rule change.
acceptance: Ordering copy agrees across FAQ/catalogue/basket/checkout.
Basket is not represented as an order; paid status remains independently confirmed.
No false permanent availability or unconditional disabled-checkout claim.

findings.problem: Absent catalogue SKU is filtered from readBasket and can be omitted by a later save.
findings.customerImpact: Saved selection disappears without a reason or explicit removal.
findings.securityEgress: Unavailable entries cannot authorise checkout or trust stale prices; no private data lookup.
acceptance: Missing SKU stays visibly unavailable through unrelated changes and reload.
Identity/quantity preserved safely until explicit removal.
Malformed data remains rejected and unknown SKU cannot be checked out.

findings.problem: Store-status events replace checkout form without focus or shared submitting-state preservation.
findings.customerImpact: Focus/progress may disappear during an in-flight request; duplicate charging is not established.
findings.securityEgress: Preserve request identity/server repricing; no automatic payment retries.
acceptance: Focused/submitting form survives unchanged status update coherently.
Availability changes announced and duplicate active submission prevented.
Cancel/error/slow response recovery works without a real session.

findings.problem: Eight of nine committed snapshots have generic descriptions; optional physical/install/contents/QC sections are absent.
findings.customerImpact: Less practical information for evaluating fit and product differences.
findings.securityEgress: No invented specs, origin, measurements, certification or audible guarantees; live content unknown.
acceptance: Every supported SKU reviewed for purpose, nominal values/tolerance, known dimensions, quantity and actual QC.
Unknown facts remain explicit/absent.
Structured, dynamic and static presentations agree on approved content.

findings.problem: Product delivery-help link targets FAQ with no delivery answers.
findings.customerImpact: Additional effort to find purchase reassurance.
findings.securityEgress: Current delivery charges remain authoritative at checkout; no legal-compliance judgement or invented promise.
acceptance: Delivery-help destination contains relevant approved answers and policy links.
No guessed charges, lead time or free-delivery promise.

findings.problem: Uncertain submission disables button but leaves its Sending enquiry label.
findings.customerImpact: Settled uncertainty looks like ongoing activity despite the notice.
findings.securityEgress: Retain duplicate prevention and submission identity; no automatic resend.
acceptance: Lost response leaves text retained and outcome clearly uncertain.
Notice/control do not claim sending or success.
Sent/failed/invalid/rate-limited outcomes remain distinct without extra POST.

findings.problem: Historical unchanged header exceeds 320px document width at 150% text; fresh 200% shopping matrix unavailable.
findings.customerImpact: Potential navigation/action reachability and horizontal scrolling.
dependencies: Unchanged namespace isolation and disposable Chrome
findings.securityEgress: Do not weaken isolation or rewrite frozen SPECTRE hero correction.
acceptance: Required five widths plus 320/150% regression and actual 200% text/layout pass.
Keyboard/focus/Escape, long content, reduced motion and action reachability measured.

findings.problem: Broad assembly/testing wording may be read more broadly than product-specific practice.
findings.customerImpact: Unclear craftsmanship/testing scope; not a finding that claims are false.
dependencies: Owner confirmation of actual assembly/QC scope
findings.securityEgress: Do not imply bought-in parts are UK-manufactured or invent certificates.
acceptance: Each claim maps to confirmed practice/product scope.
Nominal, tolerance and measured values distinguished.

findings.problem: Shared 2048-square logo PNG is 2201238 bytes for a small display role.
findings.customerImpact: Potential static delivery/decode overhead; browser performance unmeasured.
findings.securityEgress: Static-host bytes are not billed Supabase traffic; same URL twice does not prove two transfers.
acceptance: Smaller measured display variants meet agreed dimensions/byte/quality budget.
Transparency, geometry and readability preserved.
Safe browser measures caching, transfer and layout across required widths.

findings.problem: Type choices omit Mini; text search and sorting are absent.
findings.customerImpact: Limited discovery controls; no evidence of a critical search blocker at current source size.
findings.securityEgress: Filter locally; no query per keystroke or full-image expedient.
acceptance: Mini/Standard/Push-pull and long-name fixtures remain discoverable.
Filter/count/empty state consistent.
Optional search/sort accessible, deterministic and read-neutral.

findings.problem: Layered selector ownership and external font dependency complicate parity/change review.
findings.customerImpact: Potential regression/fallback risk, not universal observed layout failure.
dependencies: Licensing decision for any font delivery change
findings.securityEgress: No new external dependency/framework replacement or frozen-fix rewrite.
acceptance: Selector ownership documented and customer/technical surfaces preserved.
Fallback/delayed font/reduced-motion checks pass.
Font changes explicitly licensed and measured.

findings.problem: Single image/fallback contract may limit physical fit inspection; actual live photo quality unknown.
findings.customerImpact: Potentially fewer visual cues for markings/scale/fit.
dependencies: Explicit NIGHTFALL contract extension if multiple images
findings.securityEgress: No generated substitutes, eager gallery, real-image capture or verification bypass.
acceptance: Technical part identity/markings preserved.
Keyboard/zoom/touch/alt and byte budgets measured.
Any multiple-image model preserves provenance, verification and retention.

findings.problem: Known wide hero layout defect in unchanged main; isolated correction already exists.
findings.securityEgress: No main push, backend-dependent build or frozen-fix rewrite.
acceptance: Existing exact reviewed CSS correction released only after HOMECOMING gates.
Bounded responsive/live acceptance and complete-payload rollback proven.

findings.problem: Main still carries embedded images; NIGHTFALL solution remains disabled/unintegrated.
findings.securityEgress: Phase A HOLD; no B/C, image retrieval, publication, activation or billed-savings extrapolation.
acceptance: NIGHTFALL's documented production gates satisfied in separate missions.
No image-bearing fallback or unverified asset display.
